a.xlink:title: Grants one user access to a match's replays.
Checks whether a user has an access row for a match's replays.
Reads the stored name of a match's replay access row.
Copies the leading bytes of a match's replay files, the input of its share code.
Returns a QString from a std::string, truncated to at most MAX_NAME_LENGTH bytes.
True when userInfo may read channel.
